content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 is 15 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Program Professional II and Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available. One vacancy is for the Program Professional II post, and two vacancies are for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Program Professional II?
faq.answer: For the Program Professional II post, candidates must have a Ph.D. in Social Science and a related subject, or a postgraduate degree in any discipline with a minimum of 6 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 50 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Program Professional II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Program Professional II position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 42,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will primarily involve an Interview or a Virtual Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this stage.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual. Candidates will be hired on a contract basis for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q10. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110029. The institute is a prominent healthcare and research institution in India.
